# ReadAware

> ReadAware is a free, local-first, AI-native reading app for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android. One engine reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, CBR, TXT, HTML, and PDF with the same highlights, notes, and progress; the built-in assistant builds durable memory from your books, highlights, and conversations, and answers from your own shelf. Your library and memory stay on your device — you bring your own API key, and the cloud is only used to sync between machines.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://readaware.app/docs/): what ReadAware is and how the pieces fit together
- [Download & install](https://readaware.app/docs/install/): installers for macOS, Windows, Linux, and Android
- [Getting started](https://readaware.app/docs/getting-started/): import books, read, highlight, and talk to the assistant
- [Plugin system](https://readaware.app/docs/plugins/): sandboxed plugins and the built-in marketplace
- [Plugin API reference](https://readaware.app/docs/plugins/api/): the public plugin API surface
- [Publishing plugins](https://readaware.app/docs/plugins/publishing/): how to submit a plugin to the marketplace
